name: Open WebUI
longDescription:
Open WebUI is an extensible, feature-rich and user-friendly self-hosted AI platform designed to work entirely offline. It gives you a ChatGPT-like interface for local models served by Ollama and for any OpenAI-compatible API, with multi-user accounts and permissions, document chat (RAG), web search, image generation, voice input, tools, pipelines and a model builder.

This app installs Open WebUI only: point it at an existing Ollama server or add API providers from the admin panel. The image is large and the first start can take a few minutes. The first account created becomes the administrator.
description: A self-hosted ChatGPT-like interface for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs
